ios.desc:
AppLimit enforces app limits - without loopholes.

Choose apps or categories and set a daily usage limit.
When the limit is reached, access is blocked until the next reset.

No “Ignore for 15 minutes.”
No extensions.
No exceptions.

How it works:
 • Select the apps you want to limit
 • Set a daily time limit
 • AppLimit blocks access automatically when time is up

AppLimit is intentionally opinionated.
If you want reminders or flexible limits, this app is not for you.

Why AppLimit?
 • True hard stops using Apple Screen Time APIs
 • No override buttons
 • No snooze or grace periods
 • Minimal setup, clean interface
 • On-device only - no accounts, no tracking

Ideal for reducing social media overuse, breaking habits, and enforcing real boundaries.

Set the limit.
When time is up, it’s done.


Legal and Regulatory
In-app purchases and subscriptions are governed by Apple´s standard terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
